title: Shared error envelope (application/problem+json)
description: ENG-01 new contract. Source: SA v1.0 08.3 內部 API 共通契約與錯誤碼 (application/problem+json; code, trace_id, retryable; must not leak another tenant's object existence). `code` is an open, registry-governed string rather than a closed enum so later ENG tasks (02-12) can register new codes without a breaking schema change; known codes are listed in error-codes.json and cross-checked by tests/domain_contract_test.py.

type.description: problem+json `type`. Uses the same error-codes.json registry id as `code`; not a resolvable live URL (SA placeholder convention, cf. example.invalid).

detail.description: Human-readable detail. Must not disclose whether a resource belonging to a different tenant exists (SA 08.3 存取與錯誤).

code.description: Registered machine-readable error code, e.g. VERSION_CONFLICT. See error-codes.json for the current registry; registering a new code does not require a schema change.

retryable.description: Whether the identical request MAY be safely retried as-is. `true` is never authorization to retry a write with a NEW business key (SA BR-08).

retry_after_seconds.description: Present only for 429 RATE_LIMITED / 503 SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE style codes; honored instead of a fixed client backoff (SA 04.2).
